## Activity

Oakridge Primary Care recorded 85 captures during July 2024. This provides the activity total for the month and establishes the volume submitted for image-quality review and grading. The site should continue to monitor activity through routine reporting so that changes in capture levels can be identified and considered alongside image-quality and grading outcomes.

## Image quality

There were 6 ungradable captures. The ungradable rate was 7.1, indicating that a proportion of the recorded images could not be used for grading. Recurring camera issues should be logged with the service desk, as requested by the clinic lead. Recording these issues consistently will support follow-up and help maintain visibility of any repeated equipment or capture problems.

## Grading

Grading identified 12 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 8 days. These results should be reviewed through the usual process, with attention to timely handling of referable findings. The activity, image-quality and grading measures should be retained in the site’s operational reporting for July 2024.
